title: fetch job payload

urlHash.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the canonical URL: the key of the source's CrawlFrontier row (connectors design §6.0).

executionId.description: Present once the document's execution is known (engine design §7.5).

minBuild.description: The oldest worker build that may run the job; an older instance requeues it without an attempt (engine design §9.1).

traceparent.description: traceparent of the job that enqueued this continuation; the job's span links to it (engine design §17).

description: Payload of a fetch job: one frontier entry (urlHash) or one upload slot (uploadId) of a source (engine design §9.1).
